title: RFC 10015: Deprecating Obsolete Key Exchange Methods in TLS 1.2 and DTLS 1.2
summary: This RFC formally deprecates obsolete key exchange methods in TLS 1.2 and DTLS 1.2, including RSA key exchange and Diffie-Hellman with small subgroups, addressing cryptographic vulnerabilities identified over the years.
problem_solved: Removes deprecated and insecure key exchange methods from widely-deployed transport security protocols to prevent cryptographic attacks.
why_valuable: Provides formal standardization for removing weak cryptographic primitives, improving the security baseline for internet communications infrastructure.
